programs.description: Reeling from a sad breakup, a college student gives up on his studies to commit financial fraud. However, his new endeavour puts him in a difficult spot.
Shajahan struggles to make ends meet after suffering a huge loss in his duty-free shop. His friend Neeraj, who aspires to become a director, ropes Shajahan into his idea of making an adult film.
While looking to borrow money to meet his wife's medical expenses, Durgaprasad uncovers a deadly terrorist plot and must act to save the city from destruction.
A captain leads his team of soldiers inside a forest to investigate mysterious disappearances. However, they soon realise that the danger is more than they bargain for.
Pandian falls in love with his neighbour, Maithili, and anonymously helps her continue her education. However, Pandian's roommate, Prakash, gets all the credits for his good deeds.
Dr Nair, a psychiatrist, visits a mental asylum located in a remote location in Kerala. He meets a patient, Nithya, who is kept in isolation, and soon uncovers mysteries from her past.
Newly-weds Sreeja and Prasad struggle to cope with their lives and decide to sell Sreeja's gold chain for money. However, a thief steals the chain during a bus journey, adding to their woes.
A scientist embarks on an astronomical research journey to the Himalayas with his son and colleagues. However, when he brings a young woman into their lives, unexpected things unfold.
Majeed, a football coach in Malappuram, recruits Nigerian players for his local team. When star player Samuel is injured, he stays with Majeed, leading to a deep bond despite cultural differences.
Leaving an ambitious, busy life in Europe, Joseph settles into a quaint lifestyle with his family. The problem is, their sons would do just about anything to return to the UK.
Following the loss of his sister, a young man is forced to reflect on his childhood and reassess his future. However, he finds support and courage from unexpected quarters.

A police officer is assigned the task of solving the mystery behind a series of murders. Upon thoroughly investigating, he discovers a common thread that binds all the murders together.
After leaving his life of crime behind, Aadhi is drawn back into the drug trade by his former gang leader. However, after meeting Seema and falling in love, he decides to atone for his past mistakes.
Johnny, a bus conductor, is sent to Vamanapuram to clear a bus route, where he falls in love with his boss's daughter, who is already engaged.

The incredible, inspiring real-life story of a boy from Chambal who aims to achieve an impossible dream - passing the entrance exam of the world's toughest civil services, the Union Public Service Commission.
Gopalan, a notorious thief, teams up with Lakshmanan and continues to rob people. Their lives change when they kidnap a rich girl and find themselves trapped.
Appu, a restaurateur and surfer based in Goa, falls in love with Zaya. When she goes back home to Kerala, Appu takes it upon himself to find her and confess his feelings.
Arjun Reddy Deshmukh, a young surgeon with functioning alcoholism and a furious temper, spirals into self-destruction when he learns that his girlfriend is marrying another man.
Sachi and his girlfriend, Vasudha, go on a date to celebrate her birthday. Things go sideways, and their love is tested when they are harassed by two men on a late-night drive.

Seelabhati along with her mother visits a remote village where she starts working as a computer teacher. When some students mysteriously disappear, the villagers start blaming her educational course.
Rishi is a diligent collector who works honestly for the good of people. However, things take a turn after he draws the attention of corrupt politicians and businessmen who want to cause trouble.
Savitri, an energetic and jubilant child, grows up to become an actress. She faces several challenges and overcomes hurdles to become the first female superstar in South India.
When a prodigal youngster squanders away all his father's riches, Daya, his loyal servant, decides to help him. This takes her through a series of wild adventures that she bravely overcomes alone.
Ray, a pianist, pretends to be a visually impaired man. However, things take a turn for the worse when he unwittingly gets involved in the murder of a former actor.
Sreekumar comes across a girl while visiting his childhood friend, Govindan Kutty. However, he later realises that she is the spirit of a student who disappeared a while ago.
Mathangi's husband is a law-abiding citizen while her brother advocates for fighting for justice. As their conflicting beliefs drive them apart, Mathangi struggles to bridge the rift between them.
Following a mysterious phone call and a death, the lives of 12 friends, who are at a bachelor's party, hang in the balance, while an inebriated policeman races to unravel the mystery.
Anwar, a Muslim boy, falls in love with a Hindu girl who rejects him and elopes with his best friend. Post her death, a misunderstanding leads the police to believe that he is a terrorist.

Ambu, a carefree college student, falls in love with a woman he sees at a bus stop. However, before he can confess his feelings, unexpected complications arise.
After reading the works written by Balachandran, a publisher encourages him to publish a book. However, he struggles a lot as he faces a writer's block.
A young man who is nursing a broken heart is helped by a friend during his dark times. However, he soon falls in love with another woman.
Shivaramakrishnan is a government employee who struggles to make ends meet. In order to earn some quick money, he and his friends start a daycare centre, which proves to be even more disastrous.
A woman from a town in Kerala gets married to a hoodlum who promises her a good life. However, the situation turns awry when her husband dies, and she goes abroad to make a living.
Jayaraman, a liftman and caretaker, relies on his non-visual senses and martial arts expertise to protect a little girl from a vengeful ex-con who is out to settle an old score.
Amudhavan's life is transformed when he becomes the primary caregiver for his daughter Paapa, who has cerebral palsy, forcing him to confront his fears and learn about unconditional love.
The lives of three happily married men are turned upside down by the arrival of a bar singer. They are later reunited during a holiday in Malaysia.
Following his father's death, a man gives up on his dream to become a filmmaker and joins the police force. He then attempts to track down a psychopathic killer who targets schoolgirls.

Bharath, a technical student, has a strange habit that causes trouble for him and the people around him on several occasions.
Aaron, an ardent cricket fan, decides to be positive even after losing his sight. When he gets the chance to realise his dream of entering the cricket team for the blind, he takes it.
Sam, a football player, gets admission in a prestigious international school under sports quota. His life changes for the better when he falls in love with a girl from the same school.
The naval chieftain of the Zamorin of Calicut, Kunjali Marakkar IV, develops a highly-equipped naval defence to fight against the Portuguese invaders in India.
An unfortunate event brings Thamban and Antony's long friendship to an end. Years later, a distressing situation leads Antony to seek the help of his old friend.
Pullu Giri is trying to live a peaceful life and forget his ruffian past. Following an incident, he gets dragged into the affairs of some local gangs.
Rhythm, a pregnant woman, is traumatised by nightmares about the unsolved kidnapping of her first child, Ajay. Later, she embarks on a harrowing mission to solve the mystery of his disappearance.
Kanan falls in love with Raddhu, the daughter of a ruthless city gangster responsible for numerous deaths. To marry her, Kanan must confront the dangers and challenges that lie ahead.
When Balram seizes a cache of arms and ammunition, his investigations lead him to a criminal, Tharadas. However, it is not easy for Balram to catch Tharadas until he involves his girlfriend.

Irshad and Haseeb, two teenage boys from Mattanchery, share a passion for pigeon flying, a local game. Later, Irshad opens up about a tragic incident that ruined many friendships in the neighbourhood.
Sadasivan comes across a house where the owner, Kumaran, has committed suicide to protect his wife, Soumini. However, what is even stranger is that a man who is visually challenged is always around.
Harinarayanan, a young man who works in Chennai, is in love with Pooja, the daughter of a rich couple. However, he and his family are forced to bear the burden of tradition.
When Jayanthi's husband, Ramesh, who is accused in a gold smuggling case, goes missing, she comes to Kochi to find him. In her quest to locate him, she comes across Raju, a taxi driver.
Struggling to pay for his mother's surgery, an unemployed lawyer resorts to illegal means to make money. However, as greed takes over, he goes to great lengths to become rich.
Joseph Alex and Bharathchandran, two police officers, try to prevent Major Abu Jalal Rana, a terrorist, from attacking New Delhi.
Mathukutty, Zachariah and Binoy, whose fathers were friends twenty years ago, return to Goa in order to reclaim a casino. But they face many challenges when a local goon tries to plot against them.
An undercover Indian operative infiltrates the dangerous criminal network of Karachi's Lyari suburb. However, he must systematically climb through the ranks to destroy it from within.
Ravishankar pretends to own the farmhouse of his friend Dennis when his relatives pay a visit along with their granddaughters. Chaos ensues after his prospective bride confesses her love for Dennis.

Unni, who wishes to become a scriptwriter, learns that a director is hospitalised in his locality. He meets him to narrate his story about Amal, a heartbroken man who plans to start life afresh.
Passion and conflict intertwine in the turbulent relationship of a strong-willed couple, forging an intense emotional bond through their shared journey.
A young woman with mystical abilities confronts personal struggles as evil emerges. However, to ensure the safety of the innocent, she must embrace her powers in an ever-changing world.
Narayanan, a young man, goes to Dubai to make a living. However, he faces many struggles but braves them for the sake of his family's well-being.

Neil, a showroom executive, finds a bag full of money after a party. Later, he receives a call to meet at a secluded spot where he finds four strangers and gets involved in a dangerous deal.
